products.name: EBMX X-9000 V3
products.notes: Full kit (controller + plug-and-play harness/mount kit, heatsink, SW102T display, thumb throttle, Bluetooth module). 50kW rated, 1000A continuous / 1600A burst phase, 48-93V working (22S), IP67, VESC-based. Bike-specific kit required; V2 wiring harnesses do NOT fit V3.

products.name: VTB Controller w/ Aetos cover
products.notes: Stock Ventus part; price from owner records

products.name: TORP TC1000 2.X Controller Kit
products.notes: 700A battery / 1000A phase FOC controller. Up to 19kW stock motor, 31kW with TM25, 50kW with TM40 Pro. 60-80V nominal (up to 22S / 92.4V). Kit includes controller, harness and cover; tune via TORP mobile app. NOT compatible with the 2026 72V Light Bee (harness differs). Official webshop price is location-dependent (~EUR 1,061 incl. VAT).

products.name: TORP TC500 2.X Controller Kit
products.notes: 500A phase / 350A battery FOC controller. Up to 17kW stock motor, 30kW with TM25 (80V battery). 60-80V nominal (up to 22S). Kit includes controller, harness and cover; tune via TORP mobile app. NOT compatible with the 2026 72V Light Bee (harness differs). Official webshop price is location-dependent (~EUR 861 incl. VAT).

products.name: VTB V9600 Aetos Pro Gen.2 Controller
products.notes: 72V (20S) / 81V (22S) nominal, 1200A phase (1600A tested), 12S-22S, up to 76kW. Requires bike-specific Aetos Gen.2 harness (sold separately; Gen.1 harness does not fit). Fits Light Bee, Ultra Bee, Talaria Sting, E Ride Pro. Talaria XXX and 79 Bike Pro stock motors are NOT compatible - upgrade motor required.

products.name: VTB Aetos Max Controller
products.notes: Price verified $1,199, in stock. EVO already uses the Aetos Pro — confirm controller generation, harness, battery voltage and whether this is a true upgrade before purchase.

products.name: Torp TC1000 V1 Controller for Sur-Ron Ultra Bee
products.notes: Price verified $1,249 (V1), currently out of stock. This is the Ultra Bee-specific TC1000 — distinct from the Light Bee 2.X kit already in the catalog.

products.name: Torp TC1000 V2 Controller for Sur-Ron Ultra Bee
products.notes: Price verified $1,299 (V2), currently out of stock. V2 adds 60-80V support, 58kW max power. Ultra Bee-specific.

products.name: Ventus Aetos Ultra Controller for 118V Batteries
products.notes: Price verified $1,399, in stock. Page names Ultra Bee explicitly. REQUIRES bike-specific harness (sold separately) and a 100V+ battery — not for stock-voltage builds.
